codex.confidenceReason: Explicit SQLite thread metadata (state_5.sqlite) and session rollout jsonl confirm parent thread Terra spawned child thread with agent_role='worker', model='gpt-5.6-luna', which applied git patch to src/formatter.js and test/formatter.test.js.

historicalCollabFailure.rootCause: Flag --ephemeral in harness suppressed SQLite thread record persistence in state_5.sqlite. When codex_core attempted child thread spawn linking to the parent thread, it failed with 'collab spawn failed: no thread with id: ...' and fell back to main agent execution.
historicalCollabFailure.remedy: Remove --ephemeral and supply --disable plugins in benchmark harness invocation.

antigravity.confidenceReason: Explicit tool execution telemetry and transcript logs confirm 0 invoke_subagent calls; main agent performed view_file, replace_file_content, and run_command directly.

gaps.description: pre-tool-enforce.mjs only identifies product code as paths starting with 'packages/', 'apps/', or 'vendor/'. The benchmark fixture files located in 'src/' were not recognized as product paths. Furthermore, activeRole in .agents/state/active-state.json was uninitialized in fresh environments, so role-based guards evaluated to false. Consequently, orchestrator write to src/formatter.js was allowed by the hook instead of blocked.

Harness invoked agy directly with --add-dir and prompt without establishing the flash-orchestrator persona, instructions, or role state in the fixture, resulting in the generic Antigravity main agent executing the prompt directly without delegation.

writeEnforcementProbe.probe: Negative write probe on src/formatter.js with activeRole=ORCHESTRATOR
writeEnforcementProbe.roleIdentificationMechanism: STATE_DERIVED (hook reads active-state.json; platform payload contains no actor identity)

verdict.blocker: AGY_ENFORCEMENT_GAP and HARNESS_CONFIG_GAP: Antigravity main agent executes implementation directly with 0 subagents, and pre-tool-enforce allows orchestrator mutations to src/ files. Turn Diet optimization cannot proceed until both runtimes exercise their published multi-agent architectures.
